About the City

A Welcoming Lakeshore Community.

A distinctive lakeshore city shaped by nature, arts, and community.

Known for its waterfront, natural areas, arts, culture, and independent businesses, Saugatuck welcomes year-round residents, seasonal residents, property owners, and visitors. The City website should make it easy for everyone to find trusted information and complete common tasks.

Explore City services, applications, public meetings, records, parks, and timely notices. Clear pathways help you get to the right information and the right City contact.
